elevate.move: Give the page one real graded photograph that the signature frames: a close crop of a tread gauge or open hood inside the report's big frame, wearing the 045000 MI tag in a deep-blue/signal duotone, so the drawings become the diagrams of a real car and stock becomes evidence under the readings

Make the hero tool and the report one object in motion: checking a mileage rolls the readout to the visitor's number and re-tags and re-verdicts each report frame (DUE / AT / NOT YET) to that reading, so the digit roll is the one describable idea of the page
